scientific_assessment: Early preview only: runs 7/15/20 end at floods 13/13/15. Over common floods 1-13, alpha maxima are 0.910552, 0.900550 and 0.886492 m; population standard deviations are 0.00814557, 0.00476455 and 0.0245175 m for increasing C. The highest-load case has the greatest spread, but the intermediate-load case has the least and maxima decrease with load. This initial interval does not establish the paper's general increase in variability and peaks as the ridge develops. Early drift contributes to these statistics; wet-interface fractions remain 0.981034-1 and recorded cutoff counts are zero. The prefix does not test developed-ridge variability or localized breaches. Full histories and the fixed final-200-flood comparison remain pending.
